text:
Srija: quick flag - Mosaic-v1 q4x2 bringup showing weird detok/tokenization differences on CJK + RTL samples. Short summary: extra whitespace before CJK punctuation, ZWJ dropped in emoji+CJK glue, Arabic punctuation being separated. Posting repro + logs. @Kenji @Omar can you triage?

Kenji: thanks. minimal repro?

Srija: ran a 120-sample roundtrip locally:
```bash
python -m infra.eval_roundtrip \
  --model=mosaic-v1 --quant=q4x2 --samples=120 \
  --locales=ja,zh,ar --detok=auto \
  --out=/tmp/mosaic_q4x2_rt.jsonl
```

Srija: concrete diffs (detoked strings):
- float baseline ja: "\u524d\u306b\u884c\u3063\u305f\u3002"
- q4x2 detok:     "\u524d\u306b\u884c\u3063\u305f  \u3002"  <-- extra space before full-stop

- float baseline zh: "\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u5feb\u4e50"
- q4x2 detok:     "\ud83d\ude0a  \u5feb\u4e50"  <-- ZWJ removed, gap inserted

- float baseline ar: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645\u060c\u0627\u0644\u0639\u0627\u0644\u0645\u061f"
- q4x2 detok:     "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 \u060c \u0627\u0644\u0639\u0627\u0644\u0645 \u061f"  <-- comma/question-mark separated by spaces

Omar: initial hypothesis - either tokenizer serialization mismatch in the quant image or a detok-normalization flag drift in the quant fastpath. did we change normalize_zwsp or merge_punct recently?

Mei: we landed normalize-zwsp and merge-punct toggles in early March (PRs #4301/#4312). float images have the updated runtime-config and tokenizer serialization, but iirc some quant image bakes ran before the change.

Kenji: i'm starting a pinned-tokenizer canary with explicit detok modes to isolate: `--tokenizer=v2026-03-20 --detok=legacy` and `--detok=norm-punct`. will paste logs.

canary-bot: Canary queued: canary/5160000000-1 (mosaic-v1 q4x2)  40 samples ja/zh/ar. ETA ~11m.

Srija: also please dump raw token ids for failing samples (byte-level) so we can see whether token boundaries differ or detok step adds spaces later. i logged a few failing sample ids to /tmp/mosaic_q4x2_ids.jsonl.

Kenji: quick log excerpt from a pinned run with tokenizer=v2026-03-20:
```
INFO tokenizer=v2026-03-20 loaded
INFO model checkpoint: mosaic-v1-q4x2-2026-03-24
DEBUG sample[8] locale=ja input="\u524d\u306b\u884c\u3063\u305f\u3002" detok_out="\u524d\u306b\u884c\u3063\u305f  \u3002"  # extra space still present
DEBUG sample[19] locale=zh input="\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u5feb\u4e50" detok_out="\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u5feb\u4e50" # ZWJ preserved when tokenizer pinned
```

Mei: interesting - pinned tokenizer preserves ZWJ in many zh cases; that reduces the likelihood of serialized vocab mismatch for ZWJ. ja spacing persisting suggests detok normalization differences in the quant runtime (fastpath).

Omar: can we instrument the quant fastpath to log DETOK-FLAGS (merge_punct/trim_ws_after_token/norm_zwsp)? if `merge_punct=false` or `trim_ws_after_token=false` we could see these extra spaces.

Kenji: good idea - i'll flip debug logging in the canary to emit `DETOK-FLAGS` per request. running small instrumented smoke now.

canary-bot: Instrumented canary started: canary/5160000000-2  20 samples ja/zh/ar. ETA ~6m.

Kenji: instrumented log snippet:
```
DETOK-FLAGS: quant-fastpath merge_punct=false trim_ws_after_token=false norm_zwsp=true
SAMPLE 3: ids=[401,22,778] pre_detok="..." post_detok="...  \u3002"
```

Srija: there it is - quant-fastpath shipped with old detok defaults (`merge_punct=false`, `trim_ws_after_token=false`) while float runtime has them true. that'll explain extra spacing and punctuation separation.

Mei: infra note - some quant image bakes used runtime-config v1.10 which predates the detok changes; float images used v1.13. we need to sync runtime-config blobs into quant bakes.

Omar: mitigation options: 1) short-term routing rollback: route ja/zh/ar to float at 90% traffic and keep 10% on quant for telemetry, 2) rebuild quant images with synced runtime-config and pinned tokenizer serialization, 3) add detok golden tests to CI to catch regressions earlier.

Srija: metrics from the 120-sample run: ja->en BLEU -1.7, zh->en BLEU -0.8, ar->en BLEU -3.6 (subset with punctuation-heavy). chrF deltas small but COMET shows higher degradation for arabic.

Kenji: plan: a) push a fast rebuild of quant images embedding runtime-config v1.13 + tokenizer v2026-03-20 (infra) b) run smoke canaries with DETOK-FLAGS logged (Kenji + Omar) c) if rebuild delayed, implement routing rule (EngOps/Product).

Mei: i'll open TICKET-ML-739 to track the rebuild, attach failing samples and token id dumps. also adding a small detok-golden test set (emoji+CJK glue, CJK punctuation, RTL punctuation) to the eval harness.

Omar: timeline estimate: rebuild + smoke ~3-4h if infra prioritizes. routing change can be staged in ~30-60m if needed.

Srija: thanks all. i'll monitor canary and post results. ping @sre if we decide to route traffic. :thumbsup:
